policies.title: No fakematches
policies.text: A function counts only when natural source compiles to the original bytes. Register pins, ordering tricks and asm stand-ins stay NonMatching with a FIXME saying what differs.

policies.title: Adversarial review of every submission
policies.text: A separate reviewer that never saw the author's reasoning judges names, types and readability (ACCEPT / CHANGES / REJECT); the gate checks the rest mechanically. Only ACCEPT merges.

policies.title: Honest report plus SHA-1
policies.text: Every unit is diffed with relocations checked, and every merge links main.dol and checks its SHA-1. Byte-pattern hits and lenient diffs never count.
